result.instructions: Tools for iSpring Learn, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which learners have an overdue enrollment in our onboarding course?"; "List all users in the Sales department and the groups they belong to."; "Show the enrollments of anna@example.com and their progress.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes iSpring Learn data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run ispringlearn_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run ispringlearn_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run ispringlearn_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. ispringlearn_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: ispringlearn_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List learners and admins of the iSpring Learn account, with profile fields, status and department. Filter by department, group, login, email or user id. GET /users/v2.

department_ids.description: Only users of departments with these ids (UUIDs).

group_ids.description: Only users in groups with these ids (UUIDs).

emails.description: Only users with these email addresses.

page_size.description: Entries per page (default set by iSpring Learn).

page_token.description: The nextPageToken from the previous page, to get the next page.

tools.name: ispringlearn_get_user
tools.title: Get user profile
tools.description: Get the full profile of one user by user id. GET /user/{userId}/v2.

tools.name: ispringlearn_list_user_profile_fields
tools.title: List user profile fields
tools.description: List the profile fields of the account (built-in and custom), to know which fields a user profile has. GET /user/profile/fields.

tools.name: ispringlearn_list_roles
tools.title: List roles
tools.description: List the user roles of the account (owner, administrators, custom roles). GET /role.

tools.name: ispringlearn_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List the groups of the account. GET /groups.

page_size.description: Entries per page (default set by iSpring Learn).

page_token.description: The nextPageToken from the previous page, to get the next page.

tools.name: ispringlearn_get_group
tools.title: Get group
tools.description: Get one group by id. GET /group/{groupId}.

tools.name: ispringlearn_list_departments
tools.title: List departments
tools.description: List the departments (organization tree) of the account. Optional filter by department code. GET /department.

code.description: Only the department with this code.

tools.name: ispringlearn_get_department
tools.title: Get department
tools.description: Get one department by id. GET /department/{departmentId}.

tools.name: ispringlearn_list_content
tools.title: List content items
tools.description: List content items (courses, trainings, learning tracks) of the account. Filter by content item ids or content types. GET /contents.

content_item_ids.description: Only content items with these ids (UUIDs).

content_types.description: Only these content types, as named by iSpring Learn.

locale.description: Language of titles, such as en-US (sent as X-Target-Locale).

page_size.description: Entries per page (default set by iSpring Learn).

page_token.description: The nextPageToken from the previous page, to get the next page.

tools.name: ispringlearn_get_content_item
tools.title: Get content item
tools.description: Get one content item by id. GET /content/{contentId}.

locale.description: Language of titles, such as en-US (sent as X-Target-Locale).

tools.name: ispringlearn_get_content_final_statuses
tools.title: Get content final statuses
tools.description: List the possible final statuses of a content item (for example completed, passed, failed). GET /content/{contentId}/final_statuses.

tools.name: ispringlearn_list_course_modules
tools.title: List course modules
tools.description: List the modules of one course. GET /course/{courseId}/modules.

tools.name: ispringlearn_list_enrollments
tools.title: List enrollments
tools.description: List enrollments (learner assigned to a course) with status, progress and due dates. Filter by course, learner or enrollment id. GET /enrollments.

course_ids.description: Only enrollments in courses with these ids (UUIDs).

learner_ids.description: Only enrollments of learners with these ids (UUIDs).

page_size.description: Entries per page (default set by iSpring Learn).

page_token.description: The nextPageToken from the previous page, to get the next page.

tools.name: ispringlearn_get_enrollment
tools.title: Get enrollment
tools.description: Get the details of one enrollment by id. GET /enrollment/{enrollmentId}.
